name: Eitorf (Germany)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Eitorf (a red lion, a church tower and bells on white, blue and red).
history: Municipal flag of Eitorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Eitorf arms — lion, church tower and bells
